title: Feature request: Better prediction input values based on real time adaptation algorithm values
symptom: The user requests a feature expansion for xDrip to improve predictive simulation settings (carb ratio, insulin sensitivity, carb absorption rate) by using real-time adaptation values calculated by xDrip, with the goal of getting more accurate values that could be fed back for the next calibration cycle.
evidence_quote: I have idea for feature expansion and I think it would greatly improve xDrip overall. Idea is about predictive prediction of values set in Predictive Simulation settings (carb ratio, insulin sensitivity, carb absorbtion rate), which would be based on real time adaption values xDrip calculates.
